d: University of Prince Murgin (UPM) is hiring faculty members of the highest caliber to fill vacancies in College of Business and Tourism, International Hospitality Management Department :
Position: Lecturer/ Assistant / Associate / Full Professor

A doctoral degree (PhD or equivalent) in a directly relevant field for the courses assigned, such as Tourism Security, Security Management, Hospitality Management, Tourism Management, Risk Management, Crisis/Emergency Management, Security Studies, Criminal Justice/Police Studies, or another closely related discipline.
For candidates teaching multidisciplinary courses, the academic specialization should demonstrate a clear and defensible relationship to the assigned Tourism Security courses.
Demonstrated university/college-level teaching experience in relevant subjects, preferably including applied or vocationally oriented delivery.
Evidence of competence in curriculum/course development, student assessment, and outcome-based teaching.
Strong English communication skills sufficient to teach, assess, advise students, prepare course documentation, and communicate professionally.
Ability to participate in program committees, quality assurance, curriculum review, academic advising, and continuous improvement activities.

Relevant industry or professional experience in tourism/hospitality security, security operations, risk, crisis management, emergency response, law enforcement, aviation/maritime security, event security, or related areas is strongly preferred, particularly for practice-oriented courses.

A Master's degree in Tourism, Hospitality, Security Management, Risk Management, Crisis/Emergency Management, Security Studies, Criminal Justice/Police Studies, or a closely related field is preferred for lecturer-level appointment.

For instructor/practical-teaching appointments, a relevant Bachelor's degree may be considered where permitted by UPM policy, provided the candidate has strong, directly relevant professional experience and demonstrable teaching/training competence.
Demonstrated teaching, training, vocational education, or professional-instruction experience in relevant subjects.

Substantial practical experience may be particularly important for courses involving security operations, event security, surveillance, access control, emergency response, investigation, loss prevention, transportation security, maritime security, VIP protection, and related applied skills.
Strong ability to conduct demonstrations, simulations, scenarios, practical exercises, role plays, case studies, and competency-based assessments.
Good English communication skills, including the ability to deliver instruction, prepare learning materials, provide feedback, and maintain appropriate course documentation.
Ability to use relevant security technology, digital learning tools, surveillance/control-room systems, or other technologies applicable to assigned courses.
Professional certifications, licenses, specialist training, or recognized operational qualifications relevant to the teaching assignment are desirable and should be verified where applicable.
Please apply online and we will get in touch if the screening committee shortlists you for an interview.
The University of Prince Mugrin is located in Madinah, Saudi Arabia. It was founded in 2017.
UPM has the latest educational curricula in the Kingdom and advanced university education that includes the latest curricula and educational materials that support students to build a bright future.

Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Mona collaborates with some of the world’s most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long-lasting, and cruelty-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi-faceted jeweled bottles.

To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent by providing the most innovative & luxurious fragrances, education, and sharing Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.

As KAYALI continues to scale its direct-to-consumer business across the US, UK, Europe and International markets, we are looking for a Growth Marketing Executive to join the D2C team. Working closely with internal team and agency partners, you will help ensure campaigns launch effectively, performance is closely monitored, and growth opportunities are identified across key acquisition channels.
This role is ideal for someone with a strong interest in digital marketing who enjoys combining analysis, coordination and channel optimisation to drive business growth.
